description: Search for player identity by name. Always returns identity fields, but ownership context varies by platform. ESPN and Yahoo return market/global ownership and can also populate league ownership fields when credentials and league context are available. ESPN football also adds seasonPoints and pointsPerGame when a selected league is available: these are ESPN's actual-season applied values under that league's scoring, never a Flaim calculation. A real 0 is retained. Null means league scoring was unavailable or ESPN did not return an applied value; for unrostered results it can also mean the player was outside ESPN's bounded 100-player availability pool, so use get_free_agents before treating a null as a scoring fact. Sleeper always evaluates league ownership against every current roster in the selected league, except during an active draft, when this tool returns an error instead of an answer, since draft picks aren't yet reflected on rosters; if the league, rosters, or users can't be loaded for another reason, the call still succeeds with every league_* field null plus a SLEEPER_OWNERSHIP_UNAVAILABLE warning. Sleeper adds a Sleeper-only league_team_id (the Sleeper roster id, or null); its market/global ownership stays unavailable regardless (ownership_scope="unavailable", market_percent_owned=null) — league_team_id is league ownership, not market data. For a selected active league, use established session context (call get_user_session only if needed), then get_league_info, if this chat has not already loaded it for that league, so league-specific ownership and team names can be resolved. League ownership fields: league_status ("ROSTERED" = on a team, "FREE_AGENT" = unrostered in this league, null = ownership could not be resolved, for example because credentials or rosters were unavailable, the player result carried no usable id, or Sleeper rostering was ambiguous), league_team_name (fantasy team name if rostered), league_owner_name (team owner if rostered). FREE_AGENT is an ownership fact from a roster scan, not an acquisition guarantee — it says nothing about waiver state, so never turn it into pickup advice; get_free_agents is what reports players available to acquire. Trust a non-null league_status directly — null team/owner fields alongside FREE_AGENT are expected, not a signal to verify. Fall back to get_roster only when league_status itself is absent or null. Yahoo entries may add isKeeper as status, cost, and kept when Yahoo sends it; Yahoo has only been observed returning cost as false, so no numeric keeper cost is available from Yahoo. Yahoo results add a stats line named by the league's own categories (season to date by default; stats_window 'date' with stats_date YYYY-MM-DD for baseball, basketball and hockey, or 'week' with stats_week for football), fantasyPoints in points leagues, fantasyPointsPerGame for the season window, and statsCoverage naming the window. When Yahoo does not return stats, limitations.playerStatsAvailable is false and entries have no stats; missing stats means unknown, not zero. Use values from get_user_session. Read-only.

count.description: Maximum number of players to return (default: 10, max: 25)

league_id.description: League ID (get from get_user_session), passed whole, exactly as returned; Yahoo IDs include a season prefix, like 449.l.12345

season_year.description: Season start year — use the season_year returned by get_user_session for this league; only pass an older year when the user explicitly asks about a past season. Basketball and hockey use the start year of a cross-year season (2024 = the 2024-25 season); football and baseball use the single season year (2025 = the 2025 season).

stats_date.description: Yahoo baseball, basketball and hockey only, with stats_window 'date': the calendar day for each player's stats, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in US Eastern time.

stats_week.description: Yahoo football only, required with stats_window 'week': the NFL week for each player's stats (a whole number from 1 to 30).

stats_window.description: Yahoo only: window for each player's stats. 'season' (season to date, the default), 'date' (baseball, basketball, hockey; use with stats_date), or 'week' (football only; requires stats_week). Other platforms accept only 'season'.

name: get_players

data.description: Platform envelope. Field availability varies by platform (ESPN, Yahoo, Sleeper); absent fields are not provided by that platform.

playerStatsAvailable.description: Yahoo only: false when Yahoo did not return usable per-player stats for some or all entries; those entries have no stats (unknown, not zero)

eligiblePositions.description: Sleeper only: the player's fantasy-eligible positions, such as ["RB", "WR"]; absent when Sleeper sends none

fantasyPoints.description: Yahoo points leagues only: the player's fantasy points for statsCoverage.window, as Yahoo computed them under the league scoring. Absent in categories leagues and when Yahoo returned none; on a Yahoo football roster read with the default week window it is also absent because the roster's points field carries it

fantasyPointsPerGame.description: Yahoo points leagues, season window only: fantasyPoints divided by the stat line's games played (GP), rounded to 2 decimals. Absent when games played is missing or 0

injuryBodyPart.description: Sleeper only: the injured body part (e.g. Knee), present only alongside injuryStatus

injuryStatus.description: Sleeper only: current injury designation, Sleeper's own code verbatim (e.g. Questionable, Doubtful, Out, IR, PUP, Sus, GTD, DTD), absent when the player has none; translate codes into plain language. Present-day only; it can lag breaking news

league_status.description: ROSTERED, FREE_AGENT, or null when ownership could not be resolved, for example because credentials or rosters were unavailable, the player result carried no usable id, or Sleeper rostering was ambiguous

league_team_id.description: Sleeper only: the roster id owning the player; null when no single owner was resolved, which includes both a free agent and ownership that could not be resolved uniquely. league_status is the confirmation: FREE_AGENT means unrostered, null means unresolved

pointsPerGame.description: ESPN football only: ESPN-computed actual-season points per game under the selected league scoring; null under the same conditions as seasonPoints

seasonPoints.description: ESPN football only: ESPN-computed actual-season points under the selected league scoring; null when league scoring was unavailable, ESPN did not return an applied value, or an unrostered result was outside its bounded availability pool

stats.description: The player's stat line. ESPN: season stats keyed by ESPN's stat names, on rosters and ordinary free-agent lists. Yahoo: the stat line for statsCoverage.window, keyed by the league's own category names (STAT_<id> when Yahoo's names were unavailable; see warning), with numbers where Yahoo sends a number and a string where it sends a ratio or time such as "11/40". Absent means the provider returned no stats for this player: unknown, not zero

statsCoverage.description: Yahoo only: the window the per-player stats cover (season to date, one date, or one football week) and the scope of the stat names (league_categories). Present only when at least one entry has stats

title: Search Players
